newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lose ground in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lose ground in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened lower on Friday, as a bearish tone was carried over from the previous day's close, but brokers said the investment environment was supportive to the stock market and that the bottom side was likely to be limited.
At 0010 GMT, the key 225-share Nikkei average was down 152.62 points or 0.72 percent at 21,178.88. Its December futures were down 70 points at 21,240.
Brokers said the stocks were downward biased. "The market lacked factors to stimulate fresh buying," said a broker at a Japanese second-tier securities house.
